$comment: The tokens the kit components read. A project palette may add any number of its own on top; it may not omit these. Read at runtime by node/checks/theme.mjs and mirrored as types in src/theme.ts, which node/kit.test.mjs holds to this file.

notes.bg: the surface a scene is drawn on
notes.ink: body and headline text on bg
notes.muted: secondary text, which must still clear contrast on bg and on panel
notes.hairline: a drawn edge, the thinnest thing on screen
notes.panel: a raised surface: cards, code blocks, quote boxes
notes.accent: the one colour the project leads with. Projects had this under teal, oold and accent; the kit standardises the name so a shared component can reach it

notes.sans: font-family stack the Stage sets for the whole frame
notes.mono: font-family stack for code and values

notes.padX: horizontal safe margin, inside which everything is drawn
